headline: Discovery catalogued program IDs and repositories; insufficient block explorer enumeration for Solana; audit report reviewed but predates current deployments

findings.text: Official documentation site at https://docs.kamino.finance/ provides developer resources and SDK references; examples cite program address HDsayqAsDWy3QvANGqh2yNraqcD8Fnjgh73Mhb3WRS5E for a vault on mainnet-beta
2022 SmartState audit examined yvaults program components with verification checksums; audit predates current deployments and records only source file hashes, not deployed contract addresses

GitHub organization Kamino-Finance (github.com/Kamino-Finance) hosts 36 repositories including klend, kliquidity-sdk, kvault, scope, audits, and related SDKs; no Solana program deployment artifacts (broadcast/ or deployments/) enumerated in search results
No Solana block explorer name-tag search attempted—Solana has different indexing than EVM chains; DeFiLlama references a Liquidity Manager category but address enumeration not performed
Single Solana chain context; no multi-chain enumeration required
Scope oracle aggregator and kliquidity-sdk identify ancillary program dependencies; no factory child enumeration performed

rationale.verdict: Address book was empty at run start. Fetched website, docs, GitHub org listing, and 2022 audit. Website cites example vault addresses in documentation (HDsayqAsDWy3QvANGqh2yNraqcD8Fnjgh73Mhb3WRS5E) and klend identifies KLend2g3cP87fffoy8q1mQqGKjrxjC8boSyAYavgmjD as mainnet program ID. Audit records source file checksums only, not live deployment addresses. No Solana-specific block explorer search (Solscan, Magic Eden) was conducted. GitHub repositories lack publicly visible deployment artifact files. Downstream slices will need to perform live Solana RPC enumeration via anchor IDL or Scope oracle to discover current pool/vault/market addresses.

evidence.shows: Protocol website landing page; describes Kamino as open-source credit and liquidity protocol on Solana enabling yield and borrowing via transparent onchain markets.

Official documentation portal; contains code examples citing vault address HDsayqAsDWy3QvANGqh2yNraqcD8Fnjgh73Mhb3WRS5E and market address 7u3HeHxYDLhnCoErrtycNokbQYbWGzLs6JSDqGAv5PfF for mainnet-beta; references KaminoVault and KaminoMarket SDKs.
Audit landing page; links to full SmartState report dated Aug 27, 2022; examines yvaults program (Hubble incubator project) with 20+ module checksums.

Full audit PDF; 62 pages analyzing Solana Rust program structure for yvaults, orca_state, instructions, operations, utils; all contract methods report 'Vulnerabilities not detected'; final project evaluation 10/10; includes source file bytecode checksums.
GitHub organization page; lists 36 public repositories including klend (lending vault program), kvault, kliquidity-sdk, scope (oracle aggregator), audits, farms, kfarms, and SDKs.

klend repository; description states 'Kamino Lending is an open source software, for a lending protocol smart contract for the Solana blockchain'; readme states Klend mainnet Program ID: KLend2g3cP87fffoy8q1mQqGKjrxjC8boSyAYavgmjD; staging Program ID: SLendK7ySfcEzyaFqy93gDnD3RtrpXJcnRwb6zFHJSh.

TypeScript SDK repository for Kamino Liquidity program; example code instantiates Kamino('mainnet-beta', rpc) and calls getAllStrategiesWithFilters() and getStrategySharePrice(); demonstrates runtime discovery of live strategies.
Scope oracle aggregator repository; describes program as oracle aggregator; no deployment IDs in readme visible in search results.
Repository containing all audits related to Kamino smart contracts; listing of audit reports and audit history.

protocol_metadata.about: Kamino is an open-source concentrated liquidity manager on Solana that automates CLMM vault positions using quantitative models to set and rebalance ranges while auto-compounding fees and rewards. Founded in 2022 by Hubble Protocol contributors, Kamino enables institutions and retail users to generate yields on their assets and borrow against crypto collateral via transparent onchain markets, combining lending, liquidity provision, and leverage into a unified platform.
